instruction: What is the title of the least-played song in my Spotify song library.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only an answer. The library is abstracted by one representative object `least-played-song` (static `least-played` / `title-of` facts identify it as the answer record; its concrete identity is a runtime selection rule). `spotify.show_song_library` lists all songs (one call in the plan; at runtime it is paginated over page_index) and makes the song id known; `spotify.show_song` (no token needed) reveals play_count/title and must at runtime be called for every library song id, taking the one with the minimum play_count. `supervisor.complete_task` receives the title as `answer`, requires the representative song's details to be known, and is forced last via `(not (task-completed))` in every other action.
